name: Omanager
author: qempexe
description: Plugin manager for the Omarchy bar: browse, filter, install, update and remove plugins from a window.

barWidget.description: Browse, filter, install and update Omarchy plugins

schema.label: Colors
schema.description: Follow theme matches your Omarchy theme live. Theme palette gives every category its own color from the theme. Window borders takes the colors of your theme's window border, gradient and all. Custom lets you choose the background, text and accent. Monochrome removes every hue.

schema.label: Custom background
schema.description: Background and accent color the window. Text colors it too, and anywhere when Text is set to My text color.

schema.label: Custom text
schema.description: Background and accent color the window. Text colors it too, and anywhere when Text is set to My text color.

schema.label: Custom accent
schema.description: Background and accent color the window. Text colors it too, and anywhere when Text is set to My text color.

schema.label: Text
schema.description: Always readable keeps your theme's text color, and switches to black or white when the window is too light or too dark for it. My text color uses the Text color from Custom colors.

schema.label: Card style
schema.description: Soft fills cards lightly, outline draws a border only, flat has neither.

schema.label: Spacing
schema.description: How much air there is between things.

schema.label: Roundness
schema.description: 0 is square, 20 is very round.

schema.label: Window outline
schema.description: Draw the window edge in the accent color instead of a plain neutral line.

schema.label: Text size
schema.description: 1 is normal, 1.25 is a quarter bigger.

schema.label: Window tint
schema.description: How much of the accent color washes over the window. 0 keeps it plain, like the other panels.

schema.label: Show screenshots
schema.description: Loads preview images from plugins.omarchy.org. Turn off to stay fully offline for images.

schema.label: Window width
schema.description: How wide the manager opens. From about 720 it also gets the filter sidebar and the List + stage layout.

schema.label: Window height
schema.description: How tall the manager opens.

schema.label: Open as
schema.description: Where the bar button opens the manager. You can always pop it out or dock it back from the header.

schema.label: Layout
schema.description: List + stage keeps a big preview of the selected plugin beside the list (wide windows only). Cards show screenshots, list fits the most, compact is a dense table-like view.

schema.label: Card columns
schema.description: Auto fits as many as the window allows.

schema.label: Filters sidebar
schema.description: Hide it for a cleaner look. Search still works. In a narrow window the filters open from a Filters button instead.

schema.label: Start on
schema.description: Which plugins you see first when the window opens.

schema.label: Sort by
schema.description: Newly uploaded = first listed. As listed = the order the catalog feed returns them in (matches the website's default view). Recently upgraded = latest update. New or upgraded = whichever is most recent.

schema.label: Recency filter looks at
schema.description: Used together with the time window below.

schema.label: Only show from the last
schema.description: Hide plugins that have not been uploaded or upgraded recently.

schema.label: Verified only
schema.description: Hide plugins without the Verified badge.

schema.label: Hide installed
schema.description: Keep plugins you already have out of Browse.

schema.label: Show counts
schema.description: Numbers next to categories and tags.

schema.label: Call it New for
schema.description: Days a plugin keeps its New badge after upload.

schema.label: Catalog address
schema.description: Where the plugin list comes from. Must start with https://.

schema.label: Refresh every
schema.description: Hours between automatic checks. An unchanged catalog costs a tiny request, not a full download.

schema.label: Refresh when opened
schema.description: Check for a newer catalog every time the window opens. Cheap when nothing changed.

schema.label: Look for updates
schema.description: Compare installed versions with the catalog and show an Updates tab.

schema.label: Ask before installing
schema.description: Plugins run as unsandboxed code in your shell, so a confirmation is shown first.

schema.label: Ask before removing
schema.description: Confirm before a plugin is removed.

schema.label: Allow unverified plugins
schema.description: Off blocks install buttons for anything without the Verified badge.

schema.label: Enable after install
schema.description: Turn a plugin on as soon as it is installed.

schema.label: Show the security note
schema.description: A short reminder in the plugin details.

schema.label: Bar button shows
schema.description: What the button on the bar looks like.

schema.label: Bar button text
schema.description: Used when text is shown.

schema.label: Update badge
schema.description: Show how many plugin updates are waiting next to the button.

schema.label: Middle click
schema.description: What clicking the bar button with the middle mouse button does.
